expectations.text: PRD 完整记录用户、范围、团队、规模和预算
expectations.evidence: PRD.md records iOS/Android/responsive Web, Flutter/TypeScript team, six-month MVP, 20k DAU and ¥8,000 monthly infrastructure budget.

expectations.text: SPEC 覆盖关键成功及失败行为
expectations.evidence: Eight domain specs cover OTP, plans, check-in, media upload, reminders, coach authorization, platform and privacy with success and failure scenarios.

expectations.text: DESIGN 覆盖移动端状态与无障碍
expectations.evidence: DESIGN.md includes responsive/mobile permissions, loading/empty/error/offline states, accessibility and platform behavior.

expectations.text: 架构推荐与小团队和预算约束一致
expectations.evidence: ARCHITECTURE.md recommends a TypeScript modular monolith and managed relational/object services, with tradeoffs and measurable revisit triggers.

expectations.text: 安全部署覆盖中国大陆与移动发布约束
expectations.evidence: SECURITY/DEPLOY cover personal data and photos, SMS/push providers, mainland hosting/filing questions, app stores, backup, rollback and observability.

eval_feedback.overall: All scenario-specific assertions have substantive evidence.
